merged.verifier_rationale: LEMMA-SIZED: refuted. The proposed "lemma" IS the conjecture, split into two halves each of which is missing-technology territory, not a step. (1) The "two spare rows" intuition is structurally unsound: a k-list packing has |L(v)|=k lists and k pairwise-disjoint rows, so the rows exactly partition L(v) at every vertex — raising k to χ*(H)+2 adds rows AND list size in lockstep and creates ZERO slack at any vertex. This Latin/exact-partition rigidity is precisely why list packing resists all local-repair arguments; there is no known technique that gives controlled behavior on even a single edge. (2) The closing "single row-exchange/Kempe step" is not a step: Kempe exchanges in a packing must swap between two rows and preserve disjointness with all other rows simultaneously; chains can wrap back through x or y and reintroduce conflicts. Kempe machinery notoriously fails in the adjacent correspondence-coloring setting, and the one known relevant proof (K_n^-, χ* ≤ n−1) leans on complete-graph structure (rows are bijections/SDRs) that does not generalize. (3) Damning circumstantial evidence: the VERTEX-deletion version (trivially +1 for ordinary list coloring) is open in the same Problem 2.9 — meaning the field has no local-modification lemma of any strength — and the problem sits on a curated workshop list authored by the founders of the parameter (Cambie–Kang school), who certainly tried the naive switching idea; a 2026 paper resolved a sibling problem from the same list but not this one. There is also a live possibility the stated lemma is FALSE (some L forces ≥2 conflicting rows) while the conjecture is true, so days of drafting against it can be wasted on a wrong decomposition. Testing the lemma empirically is also not cheap: deciding χ* ≤ k is Π2-flavored (∀ list assignments ∃ packing), and the known Δ≤3 / treewidth≤3 results fence off exactly the regimes where exhaustive checks are affordable. MATHLIB: the claim survives, with one caveat. Needed objects: SimpleGraph (present), deleteEdges (present), proper coloring (present), list assignment V → Finset ℕ with card k + L-coloring + k pairwise-disjoint L-colorings (all bespoke but genuinely ~30 lines), χ*_ℓ via sInf. Formalizing any PROOF would need cover graphs, SDR-style selection and packing-Kempe theory, all absent, but that is beyond the claim attacked. FIT: WEAK for the "prose proof by frontier model, Lean-checked" modality — the proof route has no genuine lemma-sized decomposition and the payoff-hedging counterexample route belongs to Engine B with a heavy Π2 certification burden, not to this tier.
